_doc: Per-wheel gear motor profiles at rated voltage (wheel-side numbers). Linear DC motor model: tau = Ts*(u*V/Vr) - (Ts/w0)*omega, current I = I0 + tau/Kt with Kt = Ts/(Istall-I0). armature = reflected rotor inertia (assumed). frictionloss = Ts*I0/Istall (no-load current share of stall torque, derived). Profiles are given AT THE VOLTAGE THE FIRMWARE APPLIES (PWM average-voltage cap), so rated_voltage = cap.

tt_1_48_6v.label: Stock TT 1:48 gear motor (Elegoo kit / Adafruit 3777 class), no encoder

sources.stall_torque: datasheet: Adafruit 3777 'Stall Torque (6V): 0.8kg.cm' = 0.0785 N m, https://www.adafruit.com/product/3777
sources.no_load_speed: datasheet: Adafruit 3777 'Min. Operating Speed (6V): 200 +/-10% RPM' = 20.94 rad/s (Adafruit measured 250 RPM no-load at 6 V; 200 used as conservative)
sources.stall_current: datasheet: Adafruit 3777 measured 1.5 A stalled at 6 V
sources.no_load_current: datasheet: Adafruit 3777 measured 160 mA no-load at 6 V

hiwonder_1_42_8v4.label: Hiwonder TT Hall-encoder gear motor 1:42 (SKU 21100132) at the 8.4 V PWM average-voltage cap (MDD3A on the 3S pack)

sources.listing: datasheet (listing only): https://www.hiwonder.com/products/tt-motor-plastic 'Working voltage DC 3-12V, no-load speed 150 RPM, ratio 1:42, torque 1.2 kg.cm' -- no reference voltage published
sources.interpretation: same as analysis/common.py MOTORS['hiwonder'] (physics r2): 150 rpm, 0.10 A no-load and 1.2 kgf.cm = 0.1177 N m stall, 1.2 A stall, all at 6 V (A); linear DC model scaled to 8.4 V: Ts = 0.1177*8.4/6 = 0.1648 N m, Istall = 1.68 A (R 5 ohm), w0 = (8.4 - 0.1*5)/Ke = 22.56 rad/s (Ke 0.350 V s/rad)
sources.conservative_bounds: if 150 rpm / 1.2 kgf.cm were quoted at 7.4 V: Ts(8.4) = 0.1336; if 1.2 kgf.cm is the stall AT 8.4 V: 0.1177 -> scenarios.py d_threshold.stall_torque_sweep covers both
